title: Porsche Newsroom — Vom Lohner-Porsche zum 911 Turbo (From the Lohner-Porsche to the 911 Turbo), March 14, 2018
notes: Primary source in German: the 964 Carrera 4 sends part of the torque forward through an enclosed transaxle shaft. The 993 Carrera 4 adopts a viscous coupling; Porsche places the removal of the transaxle tube at the 996 generation. This contradicts the repository's earlier inference "flat underside, therefore no longitudinal shaft". The article gives no diameter, no XYZ axis line, no travel and no mounting clearance. It does not identify the variant of the user's scan and proves no 964/993 dimensional equivalence.
